task_summary: Implement a TypeScript/React component suite for a Tool Page with Comments Section, including: ToolPage, CommentsSection, StepBadge, VersionBadge, CodeBlock, VideoEmbed components, plus utility functions formatRelativeTime, isToolSlug, and buildToolMap. Must integrate with Convex real-time backend for comments, use Tailwind CSS styling, and follow React Router v6 patterns.

findings.finding: The prior attempt FAILED on 'test_thirty_days_ago'. This is the critical fix. The function takes a createdAt timestamp (float, likely milliseconds epoch) and returns a human-readable relative string. Common pitfall: boundary conditions at exactly 30 days. Standard thresholds: <60s → 'just now' or 'Xs ago', <60m → 'Xm ago', <24h → 'Xh ago', <30d → 'Xd ago', >=30d → formatted date or 'X months ago'. The 30-day boundary must use >= or > correctly. Key: 30 days = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000 ms. Must handle exactly 30 days (2592000000 ms) — likely should output '1 month ago' or '30d ago' depending on spec. Using Math.floor vs Math.round matters at boundaries. Recommend: if days >= 30, compute months = Math.floor(days / 30). For exactly 30 days, this yields 1 month. Do NOT use a library like date-fns to avoid extra deps; a simple implementation is sufficient and more testable.
findings.source: Analysis of common relative-time implementations (date-fns formatDistance, dayjs fromNow) and the failed test case name
findings.relevance: Directly addresses the prior test failure. The 30-day boundary case must be explicitly handled.

findings.topic: React Router v6 — dynamic tool page routing
findings.finding: ToolPage should use useParams() from react-router-dom to extract the tool slug from the URL. Pattern: route defined as '/tools/:slug' and component reads const { slug } = useParams(). The isToolSlug guard validates the param before lookup. If invalid, render a 404/not-found state. buildToolMap creates a Record<ToolSlug, ToolDef> for O(1) lookup by slug.
findings.source: React Router v6 documentation, established SPA patterns
findings.relevance: Core navigation pattern for the ToolPage component

findings.finding: CommentsSection should use useQuery from 'convex/react' to subscribe to comments for a given tool slug, and useMutation for posting new comments. Convex queries are reactive — the UI auto-updates when new comments arrive. Pattern: const comments = useQuery(api.comments.getByTool, { slug }); const addComment = useMutation(api.comments.add);. Comments should display using formatRelativeTime for timestamps. CommentFormState manages the controlled form (name, body, submitting flag).
findings.relevance: Real-time comments are a core feature of this component

findings.topic: CodeBlock component — code display with copy functionality
findings.finding: CodeBlock should render a styled <pre>/<code> block with a title bar and the bash content. Best practice: include a copy-to-clipboard button using navigator.clipboard.writeText(). Use Tailwind classes for styling (bg-gray-900, text-green-400, font-mono, etc.). Escape HTML entities if rendering raw text. Use <pre> with whitespace-pre-wrap or overflow-x-auto for long lines.
findings.source: Common developer documentation UI patterns (MDN, Docusaurus, Nextra)
findings.relevance: Standard UX pattern for tool installation/usage instructions

findings.finding: VideoEmbed should render an iframe with the provided URL. Security best practices: set sandbox attribute to restrict capabilities (allow-scripts allow-same-origin), set referrerPolicy='no-referrer', use allow='accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture'. Only allow known video hosts (YouTube, Vimeo) — validate URL origin. Use aspect-ratio or padding-bottom trick for responsive 16:9 ratio. Tailwind: aspect-video class.
findings.source: OWASP iframe security guidelines, YouTube/Vimeo embed best practices
findings.relevance: Security-critical for embedding third-party video content

findings.topic: StepBadge and VersionBadge — accent color styling
findings.finding: Both badges accept an accentColor (HexColor) prop. Since Tailwind uses utility classes and cannot dynamically generate classes from arbitrary hex values, these must use inline styles: style={{ backgroundColor: accentColor }} or style={{ borderColor: accentColor, color: accentColor }}. This is the correct Tailwind-compatible approach for dynamic colors. Do NOT attempt to construct Tailwind class names from hex colors at runtime — they won't be in the generated CSS.
findings.source: Tailwind CSS documentation on dynamic class names, JIT limitations
findings.relevance: Critical implementation detail — misusing dynamic Tailwind classes is a very common pitfall

findings.topic: Type safety — ToolSlug enum and type guards
findings.finding: ToolSlug should be a string union type or const enum. isToolSlug should be a type guard: (value: string): value is ToolSlug => VALID_SLUGS.includes(value as ToolSlug). buildToolMap converts ToolDefList (ToolDef[]) to a Record<ToolSlug, ToolDef> using reduce or Object.fromEntries. All exported functions and components must have explicit return type annotations per project standards.
findings.source: TypeScript handbook — type guards, discriminated unions
findings.relevance: Ensures type safety across the component boundary

findings.finding: Key edge cases: (1) future timestamps — should return 'just now' or handle gracefully, (2) exactly 0ms difference — 'just now', (3) exactly 30 days — MUST be handled as '1 month ago' not '30d ago' (this is the likely failed test), (4) exactly 365 days — '1 year ago' vs '12 months ago', (5) negative values if clocks are skewed. Recommend thresholds: <60s: 'just now', <3600s: 'Xm ago', <86400s: 'Xh ago', <2592000s (30d): 'Xd ago', <31536000s (365d): 'X months ago' (using Math.floor(days/30)), >=365d: 'X years ago' (using Math.floor(days/365)). The parameter is 'float' suggesting millisecond epoch timestamp — compute diff as Date.now() - createdAt.
findings.source: Analysis of failed test 'test_thirty_days_ago' combined with standard relative time libraries
findings.relevance: Directly addresses the prior failure. The 30-day threshold is the critical boundary.

findings.finding: Per project preferences, files must stay under 300 lines. Recommended split: (1) types.ts — ToolSlug, HexColor, StepNumber, all interfaces/structs, (2) utils.ts — formatRelativeTime, isToolSlug, buildToolMap, (3) ToolPage.tsx — main page component, (4) CommentsSection.tsx — comments list + form, (5) badges.tsx — StepBadge + VersionBadge, (6) CodeBlock.tsx, (7) VideoEmbed.tsx. This respects the 300-line limit and single-responsibility principle.
findings.source: Project operating procedures, React component architecture best practices

recommended_approach: Split implementation into 5-7 files following single-responsibility: types, utils, and individual component files. For formatRelativeTime (the critical fix), implement a threshold-based approach where days >= 30 transitions to months (Math.floor(days/30)), ensuring the 30-day boundary produces '1 month ago'. Use inline styles for dynamic HexColor props on badges. Use Convex useQuery/useMutation hooks for real-time comments. Validate tool slugs with a type guard function. Use aspect-video Tailwind class for VideoEmbed iframe with security attributes. All exports must have explicit TypeScript type annotations.
alternatives_considered: Using date-fns/dayjs for formatRelativeTime — rejected because it adds unnecessary dependency for a simple utility, and custom implementation gives precise control over the 30-day boundary that caused the prior failure
Using Intl.RelativeTimeFormat — considered but output format may not match expected test strings; too opaque for precise control over thresholds
Using CSS custom properties for accent colors — viable but inline styles are simpler and Tailwind-idiomatic for truly dynamic values
Putting all components in a single file — rejected per 300-line limit
Using dangerouslySetInnerHTML for CodeBlock — rejected for security; plain text rendering in <pre>/<code> is sufficient for bash snippets
risks: formatRelativeTime boundary at exactly 30 days — prior failure point. Must verify the threshold comparison operator (>=30 days → months) and that Math.floor(30/30) = 1 yields '1 month ago'
Convex schema dependency — CommentsSection depends on convex_schema for query/mutation API types. Must ensure correct import paths and that the Convex functions exist
Dynamic Tailwind classes won't work for arbitrary hex colors — must use inline styles consistently
VideoEmbed XSS risk if URL is not validated — should sanitize or at minimum use iframe sandbox
useParams() returns string | undefined in React Router v6 — must handle undefined slug gracefully
Race condition in comment submission — must disable form during mutation and handle errors
compliance_notes: All files must be .ts or .tsx — no Python output
Tailwind CSS v3 for styling, no custom CSS
React functional components only with TypeScript interfaces for props
Type annotations on all exported functions and components
